chars.SARA: SARA: a young Moroccan woman student wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.MAN: MAN: a tall broad man wearing a black leather jacket, a red baseball cap and grey trousers.
chars.COP: COP: a Moroccan policeman in a dark navy blue uniform with a peaked police cap.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, narrow hallway of a modest Moroccan student apartment building with tiled walls and a dim ceiling lamp. MAN has just stepped out of the neighbour's door on the right and walks down the hallway, glancing suspiciously sideways. SARA peeks out tensely from her own half-open door on the left, watching him with fear. Both clearly visible, open tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, the same dim tiled hallway. MAN stands right in front of a closed wooden apartment door and knocks on it hard with his fist, leaning in, menacing posture, his shadow cast on the door.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a small dark student studio apartment lit only by a lamp: SARA stands frozen behind her closed front door, one hand pressed on her chest, eyes wide with panic, sweating, the door handle visible next to her.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside the small studio: SARA hesitates with her hand reaching toward the door handle and pulling back, torn and scared, a bed and desk with books behind her.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Evening, a Moroccan city street with shops and a parked petit taxi: SARA anxiously points down a small side alley while talking urgently to COP, who looks at her doubtfully. Memory mood, warm sepia tint.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside the small studio: SARA clenches her fists and frowns with sudden determination, standing straight in the middle of the room, facing the front door.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small kitchen corner of the studio: SARA, trembling but decided, grabs a kitchen knife from the counter, looking back toward the front door.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, SARA flings her front door wide open holding a kitchen knife in front of her, brave and scared at once, the dim hallway beyond the door, seen from inside the apartment.
